messages.content: One fingerprint, 14 reports. Let me read one and check the code and the issue tracker.
Issue #104 looks like this same crash. I'll read it and the code at the crash site.
`Stop` closes `d.stop` with no guard, so a second call panics. Before choosing a fix, I'll check the struct and every place that touches `stop`.
The cause is clear: `Stop` closes the channel on every call, and nothing guards a second call. I'll check how existing notify tests build a dispatcher so my reproducer matches them.
